name: DIGIDRAW M3 Drawing Pen
summary: DIGIDRAW M3 Drawing Pen - M3 - - DIGIDRAW M3 Drawing Pen is Professional Battery-Free Stylus with 16384 Pressure Levels Magic Pen 3.0 50% Weight Balance 1.65mm Diameter Nib 0.03mm Ultra narrow gap Compatibility List T410 T610 TW410 TW610
description_html:
DIGIDRAW M3 Drawing Pen is Professional Battery-Free Stylus with 16384 Pressure Levels

Magic Pen 3.0

  • 50% Weight Balance

  • 1.65mm Diameter Nib

  • 0.03mm Ultra narrow gap


Dual Side Programmable Buttons: Dual side customizable buttons allow quick access to shortcuts, greatly improving your efficiency when creating, editing and annotating on drawing tablets.


Slim & Natural Pen-Like Feel:Delivers a real pen-like experience, making every stroke smooth and natural when writing or drawing on digital tablets


Compatibility List

  • T610

  • TW410

  • TW610
